title: Pallid
summary: PAL'LID, adjective [Latin pallidus, from palleo, to become pale. See Pale.] Pale; wan; deficient in color; not high colored; as a pallid countenance; pallid blue.

inlines.v: PAL'LID, adjective [Latin pallidus, from palleo, to become pale. See Pale.] Pale; wan; deficient in color; not high colored; as a pallid countenance; pallid blue.
